messages.subject: Non-recursive model: Negative Multivariate R2
parts:
Hi All,

Non-recursive models can produce negative multiple squared correlations (R2) for the loop's participants, which indicates either a modeling problem or that the R2 values should be adjusted (Hayduk 2006).  Does lavaan produce loop adjusted-R2 (e.g., Hayduk 2006)?

Thanks!
James

messages.author: ae3a6cd2c5b899bd
messages.subject: Re: Non-recursive model: Negative Multivariate R2
parts:
A follow up to my original post: As of 2011, other SEM software packages do not automatically 'loop adjust' R2 (Kline 2011).
Thus, I imagine lavaan does not. Hayduk (2006) provides the calculations in Section 6, which seem straight forward.

Kline, R.B. 2011. Principles and practice of structural equation modeling. 3rd Edition. The Guilford Press, New York.
Hayduk, L. A. 2006. Blocked-Error-R 2: A Conceptually Improved Definition of the Proportion of Explained Variance in Models Containing Loops or Correlated Residuals. Quality & Quantity 40:629–649.
